name: topogok
description: TopoGok – magyar és ukrán térképes gyakorló és számonkérő PWA

scripts.data:validate: node scripts/data/build.ts --check && python3 scripts/data/world/derive.py --no-preview && node scripts/data/world/build.ts --check && node scripts/data/topic.ts scripts/data/continents/topics.ts --check && node scripts/data/topic.ts scripts/data/ukraine8/topics.ts --check && node scripts/data/topic.ts scripts/data/grade9/topics.ts --check && node scripts/data/gen-server-topics.mjs --check
scripts.build:e2e: vite build --mode e2e --outDir dist-e2e && node scripts/data/fixtures/make-mixed.ts && node scripts/data/topic.ts tests/fixtures/mixed/topic.ts --out dist-e2e/data && node scripts/build/verify-dist.mjs dist-e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run data:validate && npm run build
scripts.data:continents: python3 scripts/data/world/derive.py --no-preview && node scripts/data/topic.ts scripts/data/continents/topics.ts && node scripts/data/gen-server-topics.mjs
